name: Bilingual Book Maker
description: Command-line tool that uses LLMs to translate epub, txt, md, srt and pdf files into bilingual editions.
whatItDoes: Produces translated or side-by-side bilingual versions of books and documents you have the right to translate. It is for readers, translators and language learners.
howItWorks: The tool splits a book into segments, sends them to the selected provider with optional running context for consistency, and rebuilds the file with the translation alongside the original. Providers are declared in a JSON file and include LLM APIs as well as classic engines such as DeepL.
models: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Groq, xAI, DeepL, Caiyun and OpenAI-compatible endpoints
